patterns.note: Content is structured into distinct, full-width blocks, often with solid background colors, creating a clear visual separation between sections.
A strong contrast between a large, bold, sans-serif typeface for headings and UI elements, and a more elegant, smaller serif typeface for body text and quotes.
A high-contrast palette featuring stark black and white, punctuated by vibrant, almost neon, yellow and green for accent and background blocks.
Content sections reveal sequentially with a vertical slide-in or fade-up effect as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic, block-by-block narrative flow.
Key information and calls to action are presented within large, full-bleed colored sections that serve as visual anchors throughout the page.

technique_notes: Content sections are designed as full-width blocks that animate into view from the bottom of the viewport with a subtle vertical translation and fade as the user scrolls, creating a sequential reveal of information. The navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the page, providing persistent access.

The site uses a bold, high-contrast color scheme where large background blocks of vibrant yellow or green are used to highlight specific content areas and calls to action, breaking up the otherwise minimal black and white layout.

Typography is used to establish a clear hierarchy, employing a modern, heavy sans-serif for impactful headlines and a classic serif for more detailed, editorial body copy, creating a sophisticated yet approachable tone.

design_tokens.type_scale: large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, elegant serif body text and occasional uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: pill for prominent buttons and input fields, otherwise sharp corners for content blocks and images.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced overall, with airy hero and quote sections, and a tighter grid for project showcases.

standout: This site stands out with its bold and almost playful use of high-contrast, vibrant colors (neon yellow and green) against a stark black and white canvas. The distinctive scroll-triggered section reveals, where entire content blocks slide into view, creates a dynamic and engaging user experience that feels less like a traditional scroll and more like a curated presentation.
